judgment.notes: The complete checked P is forall n : Nat, E : Set (GDVec n), E.Nonempty -> IsCompact E -> dimH (GDProduct E) = dimH E + 1. Thus every nonnegative ambient dimension, arbitrary compact nonempty E, the real scalar field and both closed interval endpoints are retained. There are no external E theorem ports and no extra M or background-note premise ports; H001 and H002 are precisely the source hypotheses. Fin 0 is empty but its real function space, and hence GDVec 0, is a singleton, not an empty parameter domain. No Nontrivial/positive-dimension assumption is imposed globally: 1 <= n guards only N004/T008, where positive-diameter ball replacements require it. The header has concrete, canonical Euclidean metric/Borel instances; its generic PseudoEMetricSpace helpers do not add instances to P or weaken its concrete ambient metric. Tracing each full T binder through its listed inputs introduces no undischargeable hypothesis: T003 produces the N002 data from H001/H002/T002, T004 packages it, and the remaining DAG closes at T017. Library facts remain freely available. Empty objects/shared_obligations contain no hidden construction fields or target assumptions.

Independently checked pinned Mathlib definitions: EuclideanSpace R (Fin m) is PiLp 2 of real coordinates, with ENNReal Lp exponent 2 and square-root/sum-of-squared-distances metric. WithLp.toLp wraps the tuple; Fin.snoc retains the first n coordinates and appends t, including n=0. Consequently GDProduct gives exactly the stipulated product in Euclidean (n+1)-space; coordinate extraction reverses this construction. T009 explicitly requires the distance identity and decomposition. Metric.ediam is the ENNReal supremum of pairwise edist with empty value zero. GDCost's supremum over Nonempty gives zero precisely for empty members; GDContent's proof-indexed infima enforce actual coverage and diameter <= ofReal delta. Enumeration/padding and discarding empties preserve the countable-cover infimum in both directions. GDMeasure takes all positive finite real scales; T001 explicitly requires equality with native hausdorffMeasure, whose inspected formula also allows infinity, a term bounded by any finite-scale content. Native dimH uses NNReal exponents with infinite Borel Hausdorff measure, exactly D004. T002 explicitly supplies the complete positive-exponent bridge/package. Pinned real/ENNReal powers agree on nonnegative finite bases at positive exponents, including zero; the negative interval exponent is Real.rpow on positive delta. ofReal is used under positivity or derived q>0, and dimensions remain ENNReal until established finite. T018 requires isometry, bijectivity, dimension equality, and content/measure equality for every real set, providing both directions of the actual R-to-GDVec-1 conversion used by T005/T007. These are assigned unconditional proof obligations, not assumed equivalences. No definition merely names the target or changes the metric.
